name: holdfast
description: A persistent, PTY-backed shell environment for AI agents, over MCP. Sessions outlive the tool call: real terminals, real stdin, prompt detection, secret input, and a human who can attach.

secret_band.title: Secret-request band
secret_band.description: When the agent asks a Holdfast session for a secret, show a toast and a band above the prompt that point you at holdfast attach. Off: the band's mod registers nothing.
